earlierRuns: Initial native and live collector checks failed because Windows directory ACL operations needed generic-read access; corrected before final verification
Directory handling was hardened to validate an existing owner-only ACL without propagating changes to unvalidated children
The ACL inheritance fixture initially omitted DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION; the fixture was corrected and all focused native suites passed without changing the tested production DLL
limitations: Agent primary coordinate clicks only; physical human clicks are not collected
A record proves dispatch with a matching native hit identity, not website acceptance or a filter false negative
Changed document, authority, human activity or protected/private state suppresses late records
Collection depends on admitted observation candidates and matching viewport; queries, node limits and missing frame ancestry can omit cases
Live evidence uses native messages and PrintWindow; physical input, multi-DPI layouts and child-frame collection remain manual coverage
